property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the HyphenationException (a Document).

property.name: index
property.shortdesc: The index of the HyphenationException within its containing object.

property.name: removedExceptions
property.shortdesc: A list of words removed from the hyphenation exceptions list.

property.name: addedExceptions
property.shortdesc: A list of words added to the hyphenation exceptions list.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: addException
method.shortdesc: Adds the specified words to the hyphenation exceptions list.

parameter.name: addedExceptions
parameter.shortdesc: The list of words to add.

parameter.name: removedList
parameter.shortdesc: If true, adds the words to the removed exceptions list. If false or unspecified, adds the words to the added exceptions list. (Optional)

method.name: removeException
method.shortdesc: Removes the specified words from the hyphenation exceptions list.

parameter.name: removedExceptions
parameter.shortdesc: The list of words to remove.

parameter.name: removedList
parameter.shortdesc: If true, removes the words from the removed exceptions list. If false or unspecified, adds the words to the added exceptions list. (Optional)

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the HyphenationException.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
